A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the immediate dusty environments of Seyfert galaxies are not as symmetric as previously thought, but rather are asymmetric.
Seyfert  2 galaxies are more obscured than Seyfert 1 galaxies, and that the torus is more compact in the latter.
